name: protobuf
notes: Official runtime with the upb C backend (PROTOCOL_BUFFERS_PYTHON_IMPLEMENTATION=upb).

JSON via google.protobuf.json_format (MessageToJson(msg, indent=None) / Parse). json_format is pure Python walking descriptors plus json.dumps/json.loads, all inside the timed region; there is no generated JSON code.
MessageToJson emits ': ' and ', ' separators, so json_bytes is 139/8865/1950193 for small/medium/large against the compact fixture's 126/8283/1750634; the content is canonical ProtoJSON.
Map iteration order follows the upb map, so wire_bytes_match is false for medium/large while wire_size_match holds and the messages are equal.
